explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/500 in its asymptotic form: find the Turán density π(K_4^3). The ratio ex_3(n,K_4^3)/binom(n,3) is non-increasing for n ≥ 3 (Katona–Nemetz–Simonovits averaging), so the limit exists. A single real answer is therefore appropriate. The statement is that the ratio tends to answer. Faithful.
